hero.title: Advanced Cardiology & Heart Care
hero.subtitle: World-class cardiovascular care blending cutting-edge clinical technology with compassionate, patient-centered healing environments.

sectionHeader.title: Specialized Care Areas
sectionHeader.subtitle: Comprehensive treatment options tailored to every aspect of heart health.

items.title: Heart Failure Management
items.text: Comprehensive, long-term care plans focusing on improving quality of life and managing symptoms effectively.

items.title: Interventional Cardiology
items.text: Minimally invasive procedures including angioplasty and stenting to treat coronary artery disease.

items.title: Electrophysiology
items.text: Diagnosis and treatment of heart rhythm disorders (arrhythmias) using advanced mapping and ablation techniques.

items.title: Preventive Cardiology
items.text: Proactive risk assessment, lifestyle coaching, and medical management to prevent cardiovascular events before they occur.

items.title: Pediatric Cardiology
items.text: Compassionate heart care for infants, children, and adolescents with congenital or acquired heart conditions.

items.title: Cardiovascular Rehabilitation
items.text: Structured exercise and education programs designed to help patients recover and improve heart health after surgery or a cardiac event.

whyChooseUs.title: Why Patients Choose Our Cardiology Center
whyChooseUs.subtitle: From preventive screenings to advanced interventional procedures, here is why patients across the region trust CareFirst with their heart health.

items.title: Board-Certified Cardiologists
items.text: Decades of combined clinical excellence across electrophysiology, interventional catheterization, and heart failure management.

items.title: Ultra-Low Radiation Diagnostics
items.text: 3D echocardiography, high-speed coronary CT, and modern telemetry ensuring precise detection with minimal radiation exposure.

items.title: Zero-Wait Emergency Triage
items.text: Dedicated 24/7 chest pain protocol and acute cardiac emergency team ready to intervene within minutes of hospital arrival.

items.title: Complete Cardiac Rehabilitation
items.text: Supervised lifestyle and cardiovascular recovery regimens designed to safely restore heart endurance and long-term vitality.

patientFeedback.title: What Our Heart Patients Say After Treatment
patientFeedback.subtitle: Real recovery feedback from individuals who received life-changing cardiac care at CareFirst Clinic.

items.name: Harish Chopra
items.quote: I arrived at CareFirst with severe chest tightness. The cardiology team performed an angiogram immediately and placed two stents. Within 48 hours I felt like a new person. Six months later, I am walking 5 km every morning without any pain.

items.name: Kavita Singhal
items.quote: I had been suffering from frightening heart palpitations for over two years. Other clinics dismissed it as anxiety, but Dr. Chen pinpointed the arrhythmia in our first 3D mapping session. The procedure was smooth and completely resolved my episodes.
items.outcome: Zero Palpitation Episodes • Off Beta Blockers

items.name: Amitabh Bose
items.quote: The preventive heart checkup caught high calcium scoring before any heart attack could happen. The team put me on an aggressive lifestyle and medication plan that lowered my risk factors drastically. Truly lifesaving care.
items.outcome: Cholesterol & BP Normalized • Healthy Active Lifestyle
